script.text: Hi, Daniel. Did you get my message about the client presentation on Thursday?
I did, but I have a problem. The projector in Meeting Room B isn't working, and I need it for my slides.
Why don't you use the large conference room on the fifth floor? It has a built-in screen.
Good idea. I'll reserve it right now. Could you send me the room's phone number in case I need help setting up?

questions.q: What problem does the man mention?
choices: A projector is out of order.
questions.exp: 男性が「会議室 B のプロジェクターが動かない」と言っている。not working = out of order。
女性は、5階の大会議室を使うよう勧めている(use the large conference room on the fifth floor)。

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.exp: 男性が「部屋の電話番号を送ってもらえますか」と頼んでいる。女性はこれを送ると考えられる。部屋を予約するのは男性。

script.text: Welcome to Harbor Electronics. How can I help you?
I bought this tablet last week, but the screen keeps freezing. I'd like to exchange it for a different one.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt with you?
Yes, here it is. Oh, and I also saw a flyer saying there's a ten percent discount on cases this month. Does that apply to me?
Absolutely. I'll take care of the exchange first, and then I'll show you the cases.

questions.q: Why is the woman visiting the store?
questions.exp: 画面がフリーズするタブレットを、別のものに交換したいと言っている(exchange)。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman for?
questions.exp: 男性が Do you have your receipt with you? と尋ねている。

questions.q: What will the man do next?
questions.exp: 男性は I'll take care of the exchange first と言っている。take care of the exchange = 交換の手続きをする。

script.text: Mr. Ito, I'm booking your trip to the Osaka branch next week. Would you prefer to fly or take the bullet train?
The train, please. I'd like to work on the sales report during the ride, and there's more room to do that.
Understood. The 8:15 departure arrives at 10:45. Will that give you enough time before your noon meeting?
That's fine. But could you also reserve a hotel near the station? I'm staying overnight.

questions.q: Why does the man prefer the train?
choices: He can work during the trip.
questions.exp: 電車の中で売上報告書に取り組みたい(work on the sales report during the ride)から。

questions.q: What time will the man arrive in Osaka?
questions.exp: 8:15 発の電車は 10:45 に着く。12:00 は会議の時刻。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.exp: 駅の近くのホテルを予約するよう頼んでいる(reserve a hotel near the station)。
